attributes.action: Remove VAR from English professional football
attributes.additional_details:
VAR was introduced to improve refereeing decisions, but it has also brought delays, interruptions and continued disagreement over subjective decisions.

We believe football should retain the authority of the on-field referee and preserve the speed, atmosphere and spontaneity of the game.

We are asking the Government to work with football’s governing bodies to review VAR, with a view to removing it from English professional football.
attributes.background: We want the UK Government to work with the relevant football governing bodies to review the use of VAR in English professional football, with a view to removing VAR from the professional game.

rejection.details: Decisions about how to referee football matches is a matter for organisers, not the Government or House of Commons.
